description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “HP 11E Sea & Serenity,” a spacious Gulf-front retreat located on the ground floor of High Pointe Resort in Seacrest Beach. This beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 3-bath corner condo sleeps 8 and pairs panoramic Gulf views with effortless access to the resort’s private beach, lagoon-style pool and on-site amenities. Spend slow mornings with coffee on the expansive Gulf-front patio, relax poolside beneath the palms or walk just steps to the sand for an afternoon by the water. With generous living spaces, a chef’s kitchen and Crabby Steve’s just moments away, “Sea & Serenity” makes it easy to settle in and enjoy the best of 30A. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-Front Ground-Floor Corner Unit with panoramic Gulf views and convenient first-floor accessSleeps 8 Comfortably with 3 spacious bedrooms and 3 full bathroomsExpansive Gulf-Front Patio with ample seating for morning coffee, sunset cocktails and time togetherHigh Pointe Resort Amenities including private beach access, lagoon-style pool, tennis, pickleball and playgroundSeasonal Beach Chair Setup Included for the 2027 season with 2 chairs and 1 umbrellaChef’s Kitchen with stainless steel appliances, generous storage and seating designed for gatheringCrabby Steve’s On-Site for beachfront dining and drinks without leaving the resort*** LIVING AREAS ***The living area is designed around the view, with wall-to-wall windows bringing the Gulf into nearly every moment spent inside. Plenty of comfortable seating gives everyone room to gather after beach days, watch a movie or simply settle in and enjoy the view.Spacious Gulf-front living area with wall-to-wall Gulf viewsAmple seating with plenty of room for the whole group to gatherFlat-screen TV for movie nights and relaxed eveningsDirect access to the Gulf-front patio for effortless indoor and outdoor living*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The spacious chef’s kitchen makes everything from quick beach-day breakfasts to family dinners easy. With plenty of storage, generous prep space and multiple seating areas, there’s room for everyone to gather without feeling crowded.Stainless steel appliances and ample kitchen storageBreakfast bar with seating for 5Dining table with seating for 6Gulf-front dining bar with seating for 3 and a front-row seat to the view*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Each bedroom offers a comfortable place to recharge after a day along 30A, with three full bathrooms giving families and groups plenty of privacy throughout their stay.Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities, walk-in shower and spacious soaking tubKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, patio access and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite: Two Queen beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo*** GULF-FRONT OUTDOOR LIVING ***The expansive Gulf-front patio is one of the best places to spend time at “Sea & Serenity.” Start the morning with coffee overlooking the water, gather with family between beach and pool days or settle in for cocktails as the sun begins to set over the Gulf.Spacious Gulf-front patio with panoramic water viewsAmple outdoor seating with plenty of room for the whole group to gatherGround-floor location for easy access throughout your stayPerfect setting for morning coffee, afternoon downtime and sunset cocktails*** RESORT AMENITIES ***High Pointe Resort offers a true resort experience without sacrificing the relaxed feel of 30A. The gated Gulf-front property features private beach access, a lagoon-style pool and plenty of ways to spend the day without ever getting in the car.Private gated beach access with a convenient boardwalk to the GulfResort-style lagoon pool with waterfalls and plenty of space to spend the day poolsideCrabby Steve’s beachfront restaurant and bar located right on propertyTennis and pickleball courts plus a children’s playground*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***High Pointe Resort is ideally positioned along Scenic Highway 30A between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, placing some of the area’s best dining, shopping and entertainment within an easy walk or bike ride. The 30A bike path runs directly in front of the resort, making it easy to leave the car parked and explore at a slower pace.Peddler’s Pavilion just across 30A for dining, shopping and seasonal entertainmentRosemary Beach just a short walk away for boutiques, cafés, restaurants and charming streetsAlys Beach nearby for dining, beautiful architecture and scenic green spacesScenic Highway 30A bike path directly outside the resort for exploring neighboring beach communitiesEasy access to Inlet Beach, Camp Helen State Park and more of the east end of 30A*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentOne seasonal beach chair setup is included for the 2027 season and includes 2 chairs and 1 umbrellaLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe) or Alys BeachHigh Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
